title: WATCH: Senate Hearing Goes Completely Off the Rails When Ted Cruz Triggers Amy Klobuchar After Calling Democrats "The Party of Murderers and R*pists" | The Gateway Pundit | by Cullen Linebarger
text: As Fox News reported , the Senate Judiciary Committee held a hearing on Wednesday to investigate the influx of nationwide injunctions against the Trump administration by activist district judges and to explore potential solutions to the crisis. This came one day after the House held its own hearing on the subject. During the Senate hearing, an angry Cruz went off on the Democrats for their undemocratic efforts to overturn the results of the 2024 presidential election by forum shopping for the most radical district judges in America. “Democrats today HATE Democracy,” Cruz said. “Democrats today are angry at the voters for re-electing Donald Trump…And they engaged in lawfare to stop democracy from operating.” “Now that their efforts to indict President Trump and stop voters from re-electing him have failed, they are going out to seek radical judges to shut down policies.” Cruz then had choice words for Democrats while continuing to go off on the blatantly unconstitutional nationwide injunctions these ‘judges’ have been using. “Nationwide injunctions are an abuse of power…It is incumbent upon this committee and this body to rein in the abuse of power from these unelected radical judges who are trying to overturn the election!” Sen. Ashley Moody (R-FL) tried to regain order. Klobuchar did not like hearing the brutal truth about her party’s scheme and what it really stood for. She responded by trying to gaslight the committee. At first, she remained calm while doing so. “We love democracy, and I think we should be having a civil debate on how if Donald Trump wants to make changes to the government, we should be doing it in a legal way, not how he’s doing it,” she lied. Then Klobuchar flashed her infamous temper. “And the only reason why there’s all these INJUNCTIONS is because (Trump’s) violating the Constitution,” she fumed. “Why would TRUMP-appointed judges… “Why don’t you file them (lawsuits) in red districts?” Cruz shot back. “Why are Democrats seeking out left-wing loons…” At this moment, Senator Ashley Moody (R-FL) intervened to try to stop the argument but to no avail. “Senator Cruz,” she said. “What did you just say?!” Klobuchar asked Cruz. “Why don’t you file them in red districts? Why are the Democratic attorneys general seeking out left-wing…” Cruz began before Moody called a “point of order” and told Klobuchar to resume her time. Trending: “I Hope They See This Segment” — Elon Musk Reveals He and Team Trump Have Identified the “Generals” Orchestrating the Violent Tesla Attacks (VIDEO) Cruz, though, would not be deterred. “Senator Moody, we have debates on this committee. They occur regularly,” Cruz said. “Let’s let her have her time, and we’ll get back to you, Senator Cruz,” Moody replied. “It’s so exciting to be following Sen. Cruz once again,” Klobuchar sarcastically responded . “I will be taking more of my time since he is taking more of his time to yell at me,” Klobuchar angrily added. “I am making the strong case that the reason all these cases have been filed is because this (Trump’s actions) is not legal.” WATCH: CRUZ: “‘We, the Democrat Party, we are the party of illegal aliens. We are the party of m*rderers and r*pists and gang… pic.twitter.com/NBvjHTyxBr — Eric Daugherty (@EricLDaugh) April 2, 2025 She went on to whine about Trump posting an image of himself on Truth Social wearing a crown with the phrase ‘Long live the king!’ and went back to Cruz’s harsh words to describe her party. “We do NOT live in a kingdom and Elon Musk is not his court jester!” she snapped. “No one is above the law.” “What he said was completely untrue in terms of Democrats and Republicans decrying violence,” she added. We didn’t just decry the violence. We actually did something about it…So I think that this kind of language actually makes a situation worse when it’s not even true. But unfortunately, Senator Cruz left, so he did not hear my response to what was a lie!”
